I’m sorry the birthday details disappeared after you switched the workspace dropdown.

What’s likely happening:
- Projects, cards and any saved content live under the account and workspace you’re currently signed into. When you change the dropdown, TableCards switches the session/context to that workspace. Any content that belongs to a different workspace—and wasn’t actually shared—will no longer appear in the current view.
- The birthday project you were working on is still stored in your account; it’s just not visible in the new workspace/context you selected.

Quick checks:
- Make sure the dropdown you changed is showing the same account/workspace you originally used for that project.
- If you meant to join a Studio workspace, open that section and confirm the invite link or workspace name.
- Try signing out and back in, or open the project in another browser session to see if you can still access the birthday cards where you expect them.

If you’re still not seeing the birthday content after confirming the workspace, let me know which workspace you tried to switch to (private vs. Studio) and whether you can still sign in. I can’t permanently erase data, so we should be able to locate where the project is stored under your account.

- Try signing out and back in, or open the project in another browser session to see if you can still access the birthday cards where you expect them.

If you’re still not seeing the birthday content after confirming the workspace, let me know which workspace you tried to switch to (private vs. Studio) and whether you can still sign in. I can’t permanently erase data, so we should be able to locate where the project is stored under your account.
